features: Quiet Location in Heart of Arts Centre
Great Transport Links Including the Elizabeth Line
description_html:
Well-presented one-bedroom split level apartment. Located on the top floor (9th). Stunning barrel-vaulted ceiling. Wood flooring throughout the reception/kitchen. Built-in cupboard in the hallway for coats etc. Additional W.C. downstairs. Beautiful wood staircase leading to the bedroom and bathroom. Full height width floor to ceiling sliding door/windows leading to a balcony/fire exit. Frobisher Crescent is a splendid, curved building in the heart of the Arts Centre. Quiet location overlooking the sculpture court. 3 lifts. Use of residents’ gardens. 24hr car park attendants can hold keys and receive packages. Car parking and bike storage by separate negotiation with the City of London.
The Barbican Estate includes the Barbican Arts Centre, cinemas, art gallery, concert hall, theatre, restaurants, bars and cafes. Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Tesco are close at hand. The Barbican Estate is perfectly located for the Elizabeth Line, with both Farringdon and Liverpool Street stations only a short walk away. Also, in close proximity to the various lines at underground stations Barbican, St. Paul’s, and Moorgate. No onward chain.
Service Charge: Estimated: £3,001 01/04/26 to 31/03/27.
Lease: 150 years from 2010
Ground Rent: £150 per annum
